cfg.replay: uniform with replacement; fixed chronological insertion/eviction
cfg.first_update: after inserting physical slot 1024; one update each slot thereafter
cfg.target_initialization: exact online state copy; eval mode; requires_grad False

anchor.terminal_pool: uniform with replacement among un-evicted terminal transitions
anchor.empty_pool: zero anchor loss and log event

cfg.loss_definitions: All new arms: original-unit Huber(Q,y), gamma1, terminal anchor weight1. Original controls retain their frozen losses; no normalized-loss arms.
cfg.training_time: Record wall time per fit, optimizer time and extra anchor sample counts; equal slots/steps do not imply equal compute
